Frequency once per hour

Trigger A creature touches you, such as by hitting you with an unarmed attack, successfully Grappling you, or using a touch-range spell against you

Effect Some of the lice infesting you jump to your attacker. The triggering creature must succeed at a @Check[reflex|against:class-spell|options:inflicts:stupefied] save against the higher of your class DC or spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 1} as lice distract it (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} on a critical failure). The creature can use an Interact action to scratch itself to suppress the stupefied condition from the lice for 1 round. The infestation ends after 24 hours or if the creature is fully submerged in water or exposed to a severe cold environment, whichever happens first.
